---
# References Section Module
---

```{r}
#| label: refs-setup
#| include: false

# Check if references exists and has data, otherwise create default
if (!exists("references") || is.null(references) || 
    !is.data.frame(references) || nrow(references) == 0 ||
    !all(c("name", "title", "institution") %in% names(references))) {
  
  # Create default references if not available from Excel
  references <- tribble(
    ~name, ~title, ~institution,
    "Bruce Weber", "Willem Kooyker Dean", "Zicklin School of Business, Baruch College",
    "Neil Pearson", "Professor of Finance", "University of Illinois",
    "Gene Pilotte", "Professor of Finance", "Rutgers Business School",
    "Paul Brockman", "Joseph R. Perella Chair in Finance", "Lehigh University",
    "Chitru Fernando", "Rainbolt Chair in Finance", "University of Oklahoma"
  )
} else {
  # Clean up existing references data
  references <- references %>%
    mutate(
      name = if_else(is.na(name), "", as.character(name)),
      title = if_else(is.na(title), "", as.character(title)),
      institution = if_else(is.na(institution), "", as.character(institution))
    )
}
```

```{r}
#| label: refs-html-output
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_html

cat('
<div class="references-note">
Complete contact information available upon request. References include deans, department chairs, and distinguished faculty colleagues who can speak to leadership, teaching, and research excellence.
</div>
')

for (i in 1:nrow(references)) {
  cat(paste0('
<div class="reference-item">
<div class="ref-name">', references$name[i], '</div>
<div class="ref-title">', references$title[i], '</div>
<div class="ref-institution">', references$institution[i], '</div>
</div>
'))
}
```

```{r}
#| label: refs-pdf-output
#| output: asis
#| eval: !expr is_pdf

for (i in 1:nrow(references)) {
  # Handle each field safely
  name_text <- if(!is.na(references$name[i]) && references$name[i] != "") {
    references$name[i]
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  title_text <- if(!is.na(references$title[i]) && references$title[i] != "") {
    references$title[i]
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  inst_text <- if(!is.na(references$institution[i]) && references$institution[i] != "") {
    references$institution[i]
  } else {
    ""
  }
  
  if(name_text != "") {
    cat("\\textbf{", escape_latex(name_text), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if(title_text != "") {
    cat(escape_latex(title_text), "\n\n", sep = "")
  }
  if(inst_text != "") {
    cat("\\textit{", escape_latex(inst_text), "}\n\n", sep = "")
  }
}
```
